College Football: Mississippi Beats LSU, Louisville Tops SMU

In college football, the No. 8 ranked Mississippi team defeated No. 7 LSU with a score of 32-24. This game marked the return of Lane Kiffin to Ole Miss. In another game, No. 23 Louisville overcame No. 16 SMU 41-31, with late big plays being a key factor. Additionally, UConn secured a 48-20 victory over Southern Miss, led by Kalieb Osborne.
